citations.title: More of Your CompanyCam Data Is Now Open to the Tools You Already Use | CompanyCam News Center
excerpts: Shared by Austyn • September 08, 2026

**Documents Can Now Be Created and Edited Through the API, Not Just Read** Until now, the API and MCP integration could only pull existing Documents (formerly called Pages) out of CompanyCam. You could read them, but you couldn't build new ones or make changes through that connection. That's changed: you can now draft and edit Documents and reports directly through the API and MCP. If you run an integration or an AI tool that generates project reports, it can write a finished document straight into CompanyCam the moment a job wraps, using your latest photos, without anyone opening the app to build it by hand. This is available now to anyone using the CompanyCam API or MCP integration. **Time Tracking Data Is Now Readable Through the API** Clock-in and clock-out entries are now available to pull through the CompanyCam API, filterable by user, project, date range, or status. If you send CompanyCam data into payroll, project costing, or another back-office system, you can pull time data directly instead of exporting it by hand. The team is also building tools to pull pay-period totals and other summaries in one call, so anyone building payroll workflows won't need to add up individual entries one at a time. This is live now for anyone with API or MCP access.

basis.reasoning: The September 8, 2026 announcement introduces document creation/editing through API and MCP and access to time-tracking entries through the API. These are new automation and data-access capabilities, not bug fixes or UI tweaks, and the date falls within the requested six months.
